entry.title: Three.js Architecture: ECS
entry.summary: Over the last decade of my career, I’ve seen too many Three.js projects collapse, becoming impossible to maintain as they scale. In practice, it means that logic for input, physics, and rendering gets tangled up in a single requestAnimationFrame loop, making the codebase fragile.
